verdict.rationale: Extend publishes its own API reference under docs.extend.ai/api-reference, with an authentication page and per-endpoint pages such as file upload. Nothing in the evidence shows that reference is interactive or offers runnable or try-it examples. missing for 10: evidence of an interactive in-browser API explorer, runnable/try-it request examples, code samples embedded in endpoint pages, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples

citations.quote: The Extend API authenticates every request with a Bearer token. Create an API key from your Developer settings
Upload and create a new file in Extend. This endpoint accepts file contents and registers them as a File in Extend, which can be used for running workflows
